name: OSRM
tagline: Open Source Routing Machine for OSM-based car routing, matrices, and map matching
description: OSRM (Open Source Routing Machine) is a high-performance routing engine for OpenStreetMap data. The public demo server at router.project-osrm.org exposes HTTP endpoints for route, nearest, table (distance/duration matrices), match, trip, and tile services—primarily for car routing demos and development, not production use.

auth.details: No authentication required on the public demo server; requests are unauthenticated HTTP GET. Self-hosting is recommended for production.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public demo is free with no paid plans; usage is best-effort and not for production

use_cases: compute driving route distance and duration between coordinates
build a distance or duration matrix for many origin-destination pairs
snap GPS traces to roads with map matching
find the nearest road network point to a coordinate
solve traveling-salesman style trip optimization for a set of stops
